naming_findings: The class is a GUESS(medium) STANDIN placeholder although the executable RTTI gives an owner name (the nested interface of the FunctionImpl specialization); an EXE_RTTI-based name would be more precise.
The header label line marks ICallableBase and ICopyableCallable as EXE_RTTI, but neither identifier is declared in the unit; the line describes the descriptor comment, not a declared name.
The shared vptr-storage layout type and its member are a layout-check aid that compiles to nothing.
The unit symbol-map provenance note on the sized operator delete entry repeats the interface note and does not describe that entry.
